sections.overview: Psalmopoeus irminia is an accepted tarantula species recorded from Venezuela, Guyana and Brazil.
sections.identification: In the Brazilian record, a female had a dark body, orange leg stripes and two rows of orange abdominal spots.
sections.habitat: One Brazilian record came from a forest near the Miang River.
sections.diet: The field report gives no diet details.
sections.behavior: The female was beside a tubular silk retreat about 1.6 m above ground, extending into rock crevices.
sections.ecology: It was collected in early evening; this single record does not establish its general activity pattern.

sources.title: First record of the genus Psalmopoeus in Brazil — Check List (2016)
